d: xCube is a Fintech company based in the UAE, dedicated to enhancing the competitiveness of Capital Markets in the UAE by introducing the latest financial technologies and innovations to the region.
With its origins as a market maker, xCube has since expanded its scope, utilizing its expertise in Capital Markets to provide a brokerage platform that leverages cutting-edge technologies.
The Operations Officer will be responsible for ensuring the efficiency, accuracy, and compliance of operational processes to meet regulatory requirements and uphold the highest standards of services.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science or a related field.
Thorough understanding of brokerage operations, trade settlements, and regulatory requirements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
At least 3+ years of experience in the trading industry.
Must be bilingual- English and Arabic
Experience dealing with software development teams is a plus.
r: Hands-on daily operational activities, ensuring seamless execution of trade settlements, reconciliations, and other key processes.
Monitor and enhance operational workflows to maximize efficiency and minimize risk.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements and automation.
Process client funds transfers and shares transfers. Prepare and review regulatory filing requirements in collaboration with Finance and Compliance.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, internal policies, and procedures.
Mitigate operational risks by implementing and maintaining robust control mechanisms.
Conduct regular audits to identify and address potential compliance issues.
Work closely with client services and support teams to address client inquiries and concerns related to operations.
Identify opportunities for enhancing the client experience through streamlined operational processes.
Collaborate with IT teams to integrate and optimize technology solutions for operational efficiency.
Stay abreast of industry trends and technological advancements to recommend and implement innovative solutions.
Generate and analyze operational reports to track key performance indicators and identify areas for improvement.

d: Welcome customers and provide friendly, professional assistance. Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate products. Provide accurate information regarding products, sizes, prices and promotions. Use cross-selling and upselling techniques to maximize sales. Work towards individual and store sales targets. Maintain strong product and promotional knowledge. Keep the sales floor clean, organized and fully replenished. Ensure merchandise is correctly organised and displayed. Verify all display testers and record necessary details. Report any damaged or missing inventory directly to the floor supervisor. Replenish merchandise from the stockroom. Check product pricing and tagging accuracy. Support visual merchandising changes when required. Assist with stock counts and inventory activities. Support cashiering activities where trained and authorized. Handle customer concerns professionally and escalate when necessary. Follow OVS grooming, attendance and conduct standards. Support loss-prevention procedures.
